# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Apple Tightens macOS Disk Access as AI Agents Expand](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-tightens-macos-agent-access.html): Apple will add stricter controls to macOS Full Disk Access, responding to privacy risks created by increasingly autonomous desktop AI agents.
- [BootLoops Open-Sources Tools for Exact Science Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/bootloops-scientific-agent-tools.html): BootLoops releases an open toolkit that gives AI agents certified computational tools for high-precision physics and quantitative research.
- [FieldAI Reportedly Seeks $700 Million for Robot Brain](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/fieldai-robotics-funding-round.html): FieldAI is reportedly raising $700 million at a $10 billion valuation to scale one autonomy layer across humanoids, drones and industrial robots.
- [Meta Opens Muse Gadget Code for DIY AI Hardware](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-opens-muse-gadget-code.html): Meta is opening Muse gadget software for ESP32 boards and Raspberry Pi devices, extending its personal agent beyond phones and computers.
- [Microsoft Releases MAI-Transcribe-2 for Live Speech](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/microsoft-mai-streaming-transcription.html): Microsoft’s new streaming model transcribes speech continuously in 60 languages, targeting voice agents that must reason before a speaker finishes.
- [Prime Intellect Launches Serving Layer for Open Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/prime-inference-open-model-serving.html): Prime Inference offers serverless and reserved hosting for frontier open models, linking deployment traffic with the company’s continual-training loop.
- [Stability AI Rebuilds Around Licensed Music Creation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/stability-ai-pivots-to-music.html): Stability AI is redirecting its business toward professional music tools after securing label-backed funding and releasing new audio models.
- [Cloudflare Releases Open-Weight Clef Decision Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cloudflare-clef-decision-models.html): Cloudflare released two open-weight models that return calibrated decisions instead of text, targeting faster and cheaper control loops for AI agents.
- [Cohere Launches Embed 5 for Enterprise Retrieval](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cohere-embed-five-retrieval.html): Cohere introduced Pro and Fast versions of Embed 5, sharing one embedding space so enterprises can trade retrieval quality for latency without reindexing.
- [DeepSeek Opens Harness Desktop Agent for Local Work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-harness-desktop-agent.html): DeepSeek has released Harness for macOS and Windows, combining local file access, coding, background tasks and extensible agent plugins.
- [AWS Releases Open Strands Decider 2B for Agent Decisions](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/strands-decider-2b-open-model.html): AWS has open-sourced a 2-billion-parameter decision model that returns calibrated choices in roughly 115 milliseconds for agent workflows.
- [DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Kernels for V4.1 Inference](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-ascend-open-source.html): DeepSeek has released optimized attention kernels for Huawei’s Ascend 950, showing how open software can improve China’s alternative AI stack.
- [Google Introduces Gemini 4 Argon in Frontier Model Push](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-4-argon-frontier-model.html): Google’s Gemini 4 Argon narrows the performance gap with OpenAI and Anthropic, but early results show a competitive field rather than a new leader.
- [OpenAI and Synopsys Build Model for Chip Design Workflows](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-synopsys-chip-design.html): OpenAI and Synopsys will develop GPT-Synopsys, an agentic system intended to operate EDA tools and optimize semiconductor designs.
- [Google DeepMind Watermarks AI-Designed Proteins in Lab Tests](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/synthid-bio-protein-watermarking.html): SynthID Bio embeds detectable signatures into protein sequences and structures while preserving tested binding performance and biological function.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [苹果收紧 macOS 全盘访问权限，应对 AI 代理风险](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-tightens-macos-agent-access.html): 苹果将加强 macOS“全盘访问”控制，要求用户更明确地授权，以应对桌面 AI 代理带来的隐私风险。
- [BootLoops开源面向科学代理的精确计算工具](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/bootloops-scientific-agent-tools.html): BootLoops发布开源工具包，为AI代理提供高精度物理和定量科学计算能力，并配套可复用的代理技能协议。
- [FieldAI据报拟融资7亿美元，估值达100亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/fieldai-robotics-funding-round.html): FieldAI据报正以100亿美元估值筹集7亿美元，用一套自主系统覆盖人形机器人、无人机和工业机器人。
- [Meta 开放 Muse 设备代码，试水社区自制 AI 硬件](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-opens-muse-gadget-code.html): Meta 开放 Muse 设备代码，支持 ESP32 和树莓派，让开发者把个人 AI 代理接入屏幕、传感器与家用设备。
- [微软发布MAI-Transcribe-2流式语音模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/microsoft-mai-streaming-transcription.html): 微软新模型支持60种语言的连续转写，让语音代理能在用户说完之前开始理解请求、准备工具调用。
- [Prime Intellect推出开源前沿模型托管平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/prime-inference-open-model-serving.html): Prime Inference同时提供无服务器和预留容量服务，试图把开源模型部署、用户反馈与持续训练连接成一条闭环。
- [Stability AI 转向音乐，押注授权数据与专业工具](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/stability-ai-pivots-to-music.html): Stability AI 正将业务重心转向专业音乐创作，依靠唱片公司投资、授权曲库和新一代音频模型重建公司。
- [Cloudflare开源Clef决策模型，专为智能体快速判断](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cloudflare-clef-decision-models.html): Cloudflare发布两款开放权重决策模型，直接输出带概率的结构化判断，为智能体提供更快、更便宜的控制环节。
- [Cohere发布Embed 5，检索模型可在速度与质量间切换](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cohere-embed-five-retrieval.html): Cohere推出Embed 5 Pro与Fast，两者共享向量空间，企业无需重建索引即可在检索质量和延迟之间调整。
- [DeepSeek推出Harness桌面智能体，支持本地长期任务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-harness-desktop-agent.html): DeepSeek面向macOS和Windows发布Harness桌面智能体，整合本地文件、编程、后台任务和可扩展插件。
- [AWS开源Strands Decider 2B，专为智能体决策而生](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/strands-decider-2b-open-model.html): AWS开源一款20亿参数决策模型，可在约115毫秒内返回带校准概率的选项结果，面向智能体工作流部署。
- [DeepSeek 开源昇腾算子，补强国产推理软件栈](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-ascend-open-source.html): DeepSeek 面向华为昇腾 950 开源稀疏注意力算子，显示国产 AI 硬件能否竞争，关键也在软件优化。
- [谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，前沿模型竞争再加码](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-4-argon-frontier-model.html): Gemini 4 Argon 缩小了与 OpenAI、Anthropic 的性能差距，但目前更像强势追赶者，而非已经确立领先地位。
- [OpenAI 携手 Synopsys，开发芯片设计专用模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-synopsys-chip-design.html): OpenAI 与 Synopsys 将共同开发 GPT-Synopsys，让智能体直接操作 EDA 工具并迭代优化芯片设计。
- [Google DeepMind 推出 SynthID Bio，为 AI 蛋白质加水印](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/synthid-bio-protein-watermarking.html): SynthID Bio 可在蛋白质序列和结构中嵌入可检测标记，实验显示其未明显影响结合能力与生物功能。

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
